item.title: It's not just the U.S., the movement against data centers is global
item.description: Activists protesting data centers in their backyards are teaming up to learn tactics from allies around the world. "We are coordinated and we are together," said one Spanish activist.

item.title: How the tech industry and markets have responded to Jensen Huang's resignation
item.description: We look at the industry and market response to news that NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang was forced to step down after reports of affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and two of his employees.

item.title: Hello? James Gleick's new book compares the history of the telephone to the modern era
item.description: Have you ever wondered where phone etiquette or the idea for the first social network came from? Author James Gleick talks about his new book, The Telephone.

item.title: Microsoft outage disrupts work and gives some a chance to unplug
item.description: Millions of individuals, organizations and businesses were left without access to Microsoft's Outlook email on Thursday. Some people celebrated a day without email, while others work around obstacles.

item.title: Colette Kress becomes Nvidia's interim CEO after Jensen Huang resigns
item.description: Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang is out, and the company's chief financial officer Colette Kress is taking over as interim CEO. She'll have to guide the company through an exceptionally challenging time.
